# Free DeepSeek API

> OpenAI-compatible proxy for `chat.deepseek.com` (DeepSeek web endpoint) with native PoW, streaming, emulated tool-calling, and zero npm runtime dependencies.

- Repo: https://github.com/zeroaiproject/Free-DeepSeek-API
- License: GLWTS
- Runtime: Node.js >= 18, CommonJS, no npm runtime dependencies
- Context advertised: **1M tokens** (`deepseek-chat`, `deepseek-reasoner`) — effective limit depends on upstream

## What it does

- OpenAI-compatible API backed by DeepSeek web `userToken`s:
  - `GET /`, `/v1` — service info (HTML for browsers, JSON for clients)
  - `GET /health` — status, uptime, masked token/warm/rate/watchdog/auth, metrics & rates
  - `GET /metrics` — Prometheus text (or JSON with `Accept: application/json`)
  - `GET /v1/models` — models + capability hints
  - `POST /v1/chat/completions` — streaming/non-streaming, `tools`/`tool_choice`/`parallel_tool_calls`, reasoning (`reasoning_content`)
- Solves `DeepSeekHashV1` PoW natively via shipped WASM (`lib/sha3_wasm_bg.*.wasm`).
- Emulates tool calling (web has none): injects schemas, parses JSON and DSML outputs, stream-safe hold-back to prevent markup leaks.
- Resilience: round-robin token pool, hot token reload, pacing (bucket + jitter/gap + escalating cooldown), one in-flight completion per token, pre-warm (challenges/sessions), staggered watchdog, optional auto re-login and outbound proxy, metrics/rate/latency visibility.

## How it works (high level)

1. **PoW**: fetch challenge → solve custom Keccak WASM hash → send `X-Ds-Pow-Response` (solved answer single-use, unsolved challenges reusable within TTL).
2. **Session**: create/reuse chat session (`parent_message_id: null` branches), rotate periodically.
3. **Completion**: POST flattened prompt to `/api/v0/chat/completion` (SSE), translate fragments/patches into OpenAI deltas/messages (`THINK` → `reasoning_content`).
4. **Tools**: prompt-injected schemas; replies parsed as JSON or DSML into `tool_calls`; streamgate holds back tail to avoid leaking markers.

## Quick start

```bash
git clone https://github.com/zeroaiproject/Free-DeepSeek-API.git
cd free-deepseek-api
cp .env.example .env
echo "$DEEPSEEK_USER_TOKEN" > tokens.txt
./run.sh  # or npm start | docker compose up -d
```

Token: `localStorage.getItem('userToken')` on https://chat.deepseek.com or `node scripts/login.js <email> <password>`.

## Tutorials (coding agents)

See `tutos/README.md`: SETUP, OPENCODE, CLAUDECODE, CURSOR, WINDSURF, CLINE, CONTINUE, AIDER, GITHUB_COPILOT, CODEX_CLI, ZED, JETBRAINS, OPENAI_SDK. Base URL `http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1`.

## Important behavior and limits

- **No refresh token:** re-mint via login/register/oauth only; auto re-login needs password.
- **`40003`:** revocation (recoverable by re-login) vs **account suspension** (not recoverable until expiry) — proxy backs off and reports in `/health`.
- **Silent throttling:** empty 200 stream under burst; proxy paces/waits/retries with jitter and escalating cooldown.
- **Anti-suspension not guaranteed:** signals reduced (pacing, gaps, jitter, reuse, staggered warm/watchdog) but policy decisions are upstream.
- **Security:** keep `.env`/`tokens.txt` private (gitignored, `0600`); use `API_KEY` if exposed.

## Key files

- `server.js` — HTTP server, OpenAI compatibility, routing, metrics
- `lib/deepseek.js`, `lib/pow.js`, `lib/sha3_wasm_bg.*.wasm` — upstream client & PoW
- `lib/tools.js`, `lib/streamgate.js`, `lib/stream.js` — tool emulation & streaming
- `lib/pool.js`, `lib/ratelimit.js`, `lib/warm.js`, `lib/watchdog.js` — token/rate/session lifecycle
- `lib/auth.js`, `lib/signup.js`, `lib/captcha.js`, `lib/mailbox.js` — auth & signup
- `lib/metrics.js`, `lib/env.js` — metrics & config
- `scripts/`, `tutos/` — CLI/tests/bench and integration guides

## Tests

```bash
npm run test:offline   # parsers + streamgate + PoW
npm run test:all       # offline + signup gate smoke (network)
```
